02

Sanjhi Soch, Sunehra Kal — Premium basmati rice (FMCG, packaged staples)

Idea

Where it sits
classiccontemporary
quietloud
warmcool
friendauthority
Feels
assuredrootedcalm
The idea

The Devanagari headline that joins letters into one word: a gold line holds three grains in the mark, gives the inscriptional capitals their hanging rule, and is the only gold in a forest-and-ivory palette.

One loud thing

The gold joining line: the single bright element in mark, layout and pack.

Where it differs

Category marks are crests, monuments and leaves on maroon or kraft; this is a script-derived abstract mark in deep forest with one line of gold, no illustration.

The mark

One line joins three grains into a single word: shirorekha, panicle and toran at once.

03

Logo

The symbol + wordmark is the primary logo. Use it wherever the space allows; every other version is derived from it.

Clear space

Keep at least x = 1 × the wordmark's cap height free on every side. (inferred from the drawing; confirm before print)

  • Use the supplied files in kit/logo; never retype or redraw the wordmark.
  • Scale proportionally, from the corner.
  • The guide lines show the cap height and baseline the lockup is aligned on.

Brand guidelinesVersion 1.0October, 2026
04

Logo

Pick the version by the space, not by taste. When the primary logo would render smaller than 20 px tall, switch to the symbol.

Primary

Horizontal lockup. The default for headers, documents and signage.

Stacked

For square and narrow spaces where the horizontal lockup gets too small.

Symbol

On its own only where the brand is already named nearby: avatars, app icons.

Favicon

The symbol on the primary colour at 48, 32 and 16 px.

Don't recolour
Don't add effects
Don't crowd the clear space

06

Deep Sangat forest on warm ivory, one line of muted gold.

Colours

Band heights show how much of each colour a typical page uses. Large areas take the ground and primary; the accent stays small.

Print

Screen values are exact. For print, ask your printer for CMYK/Pantone matches made with their profile; the Lab D50 values are the reference to match against.

Tints

80, 50 and 20% for charts and backgrounds only, never for text.

12

Placeholder icons, not drawn for this brand. Draw the brand's own set to the rules on the left.

Icons

  • 24 px grid, 2 px padding, 1.75 px stroke.
  • Round caps and joins; no fills except for a selected state.
  • Icons take the ink or primary colour, never the accent.
  • Sample set shown in the system style; draw new icons to match.

Brand guidelinesVersion 1.0October, 2026
13

Not defined in this kit: the panels show colour treatment only, and the rules are a starting point to replace with the brand's own.

Imagery

  • Real people, real places; natural light.
  • Duotone in the primary and ink for backgrounds behind text.
  • The accent appears in pictures only where it already exists in the scene.
  • No stock clichés: no handshakes, no glowing orbs.
